title: Vertical vs horizontal scaling
description: Learn about Vertical vs horizontal scaling. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Vertical vs horizontal scaling** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with vertical vs horizontal scaling.

items: Understand the core differences between vertical and horizontal scaling
Know when to choose vertical over horizontal scaling
Recognize the trade-offs involved in each approach
Apply the right tool for the specific problem context

data.text: Understanding vertical vs horizontal scaling is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with vertical vs horizontal scaling, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
